review.why: Plans multi-source research, flags contradictions and gaps, and archives each cited brief for later search.
review.summary: Seven-step research flow: frame the question and the decision it informs, plan sources (web search, URLs, browsable pages, memory, Notion, past archive), collect with dates and confidence, synthesize with a contradiction check, output a brief with citations and gaps, archive it, and offer to push it elsewhere.
strengths: Contradictions and gaps are surfaced, not averaged away
Confidence level and source recency on every finding
Archives to a user folder outside the skill so upgrades keep it
cautions: Relies on other tools (last30days, agent-browser, Notion) that are not included
Not for standing monitoring, which it leaves to another skill
